prompt: Objective: find why a software company's margin fell from 20% to 8%. What you've learned: revenue grew 25%. Latest finding: headcount grew 60%, mostly in sales. What is the best next step?

options.text: Find out why revenue grew only 25%
options.feedback: Revenue grew; the margin fell because costs grew faster.

options.text: Compare revenue per salesperson before and after hiring
options.feedback: Right. Sales hiring outran revenue. Productivity per salesperson shows whether the new hires are paying off.

options.text: Compare cloud costs with industry benchmarks
options.feedback: The finding points to headcount, not cloud costs.

options.text: Estimate savings from cutting 30% of the sales team this year
options.feedback: That jumps to a fix before knowing whether the hires are ramping up.

explanation: Headcount grew 60%, mostly in sales, against 25% revenue growth. Check sales productivity before and after.
